replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: To solve a second order algebraic equation, first bring all terms to one side so the equation equals zero. To find the stationary points, first compute the derivative f '(x) of the function. Set f '(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are potential stationary points.
